INSERT INTO security_scanning_settings (project_id, enabled, scanners, interval_hours, user_id, next_run_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
         ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = $2, scanners = $3, interval_hours = $4, user_id = $5, next_run_at = $6,
                                                updated_at = now()
